skills.grammarMd:
**Ez duh çûm çem.** Yesterday I went to the river. Verbs like *çûn* go, *hatin* come and *ketin* fall use their past stem with the endings **-im, -î, —, -in**: *ez çûm, tu çûyî, ew çû, em çûn*.

- *ez hatim, ew hat* · *ez ketim, ew ket* · *ez mam, ew ma* (stayed)
- “Didn’t” is **ne-** in front: *ez neçûm*, *ew nehat*.

lines.text: Ev ne şopên beranan in. Ev şopên Bozo ne!
lines.en: These aren’t rams’ tracks. These are Bozo’s tracks!

lines.text: Hevalo bi şopan re diçe. Em jî biçin!
lines.en: Hevalo is following the tracks. Let’s go too!

lines.text: Baweriya min bi Hevalo heye. Em di nav daristanê re daketin, û ev kanî ye.
lines.en: I trust Hevalo. We’ve come down through the forest, and here’s the spring.

lines.text: Û Bozo li vir e, bi kera biçûk a Ferhad re!
lines.en: And Bozo is here, with Ferhad’s little donkey!

lines.text: Binêre, Bozo li wê dinêre, û ew jî li Bozo dinêre.
lines.en: Look, Bozo is looking at her, and she is looking at Bozo.

lines.text: Bozo şermok e?
lines.en: Is Bozo shy?

lines.text: Na, îro Bozo wêrek e. Bozo evîndar e!
lines.en: No, today Bozo is brave. Bozo is in love!

lines.text: Em ê ji Ferhad re bibêjin?
lines.en: Shall we tell Ferhad?

lines.text: Na! Evîn nehênî ye. Em ji Ferhad re nabêjin.
lines.en: No! Love is a secret. We’re not telling Ferhad.
